items.name: Silicone test lead wire, 18 AWG, 50 ft, black
items.use: Unterminated 50 ft reel of 18 AWG silicone lead wire for building custom-length test leads or jumpers. CAT III applies only if every part of the finished lead (plugs, clips) is also CAT III-rated; the MDP and 1825 plugs in this list are not.
items.rating: 10,000 VDC / 20 A, hands-free testing in a controlled voltage environment only. Not for handheld use above 30 Vrms / 42.2 Vpk / 60 Vdc or above 8 A. Datasheet says the wire will comply with CAT III, IEC 61010-031 when correctly terminated with other CAT III-rated parts. The wire alone is not a CAT-rated test lead, and no CAT voltage is stated.
items.notes: Official page covers both 6733-0 (black) and 6733-2 (red). 192×41 bare copper, dual-extruded silicone with white wear indicator, OD 0.144 in (3.60 mm), −50 to +150 °C.
field_notes: Bare wire only. It is not a CAT-rated lead until every plug and clip on it is CAT III-rated too.
Don't hold a lead made from it on live parts above 30 Vrms / 42.2 Vpk / 60 Vdc or 8 A.
The 10,000 VDC figure is hands-free only, in a controlled test setup. It is not a rating for energized power gear.

items.name: Silicone test lead wire, 18 AWG, 50 ft, red
items.use: Same 18 AWG silicone lead wire as 6733-0, in red, for building custom-length leads that pair with the black reel. Not a CAT-rated lead unless every termination is CAT III-rated.
items.rating: 10,000 VDC / 20 A, hands-free testing in a controlled voltage environment only. Not for handheld use above 30 Vrms / 42.2 Vpk / 60 Vdc or above 8 A. Datasheet says the wire will comply with CAT III, IEC 61010-031 when correctly terminated with other CAT III-rated parts. The wire alone is not a CAT-rated test lead, and no CAT voltage is stated.
items.notes: Same official product page as 6733-0.
field_notes: Same as the black reel: not a CAT-rated lead until every termination is CAT III-rated.
Don't hold it on live parts above 30 Vrms / 42.2 Vpk / 60 Vdc or 8 A.

items.name: Stackable double banana plug with cable guide, black
items.use: Solderless set-screw double banana plug for building 0.75 in-spaced leads or stacking connections on banana-jack instruments and fixtures. Not CAT-rated; not for handheld use above 33 Vrms / 70 Vdc.
items.rating: 15 A; 5000 Vrms max hands-free in a controlled environment; +50 °C max. Not for handheld use above 33 Vrms / 70 Vdc. No IEC CAT rating on the official datasheet.
items.notes: Official name is a stackable double banana plug with cable guide; Newark's listing called it an adaptor. Do not confuse with MDP-0# bulk packaging.
field_notes: Not CAT-rated. Don't hold it on live parts above 33 Vrms / 70 Vdc.
Good for bench and fixture hookups, not for probing energized gear by hand.

items.name: Solderless stackable banana plug with safety collar, black, 10-pack
items.use: Do-it-yourself 4 mm banana plug that clamps onto 18–22 AWG lead wire with a set screw, used to make or repair custom test leads. Not CAT-rated, so not a CAT III lead on its own.
items.rating: 15 A; 5000 Vrms max hands-free in a controlled environment; +50 °C max. Do not hold in hand above 30 Vrms / 60 Vdc. No IEC CAT rating on the official datasheet.
items.notes: Newark manufacturer part is listed as 1825-0 10PK; pack of 10. Official Pomona page lists 10 per package. Digi-Key also carries 1825-0 but sells it as individual plugs (https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/pomona-electronics/1825-0/603383), Mouser carries the 10-pack.
field_notes: Not CAT-rated, so a lead built with it is not a CAT III lead.
Don't hold it on live parts above 30 Vrms / 60 Vdc. Not for circuits where transients can exceed its rating.

items.name: Solderless stackable banana plug with safety collar, red, 10-pack
items.use: Same do-it-yourself 4 mm banana plug as 1825-0, in red, for terminating the red lead wire on custom test leads. Not CAT-rated, so not a CAT III lead on its own.
items.rating: 15 A; 5000 Vrms max hands-free in a controlled environment; +50 °C max. Do not hold in hand above 30 Vrms / 60 Vdc. No IEC CAT rating on the official datasheet.
items.notes: Newark manufacturer part is listed as 1825-2 10PK; pack of 10. Same official page as 1825-0. Digi-Key also carries 1825-2 as individual plugs (https://www.digikey.com/en/products/detail/pomona-electronics/1825-2/603384).
field_notes: Not CAT-rated, so a lead built with it is not a CAT III lead.
Don't hold it on live parts above 30 Vrms / 60 Vdc. Not for circuits where transients can exceed its rating.

items.name: Medium alligator clip set for 4 mm sheathed banana plugs, red/black pair
items.use: Snaps onto 4 mm sheathed DMM test leads so a tech can clip onto terminals and hardware up to 0.3 in (7.6 mm). CAT rating covers the clip only; leads, plugs and meter must also be rated for the circuit.
items.rating: IEC 61010-031, 1000 V CAT II / 600 V CAT III, 10 A; −20 to 55 °C; pollution degree 2, 2000 m.
items.notes: Official model is 5916B; Newark lists 5916B/POM. Pack is one black and one red clip (pack of 2), not a 10-pack. Accepts 4 mm sheathed safety banana plugs (Pomona cites 5907A/5908A/5909A).
field_notes: The only CAT-rated clip in this list: 1000 V CAT II / 600 V CAT III, 10 A.
The rating covers the clip only. Leads, plugs and meter must also be rated for the circuit.

items.name: Alligator clip with banana jack and flex boot, black, 10-pack
items.use: Takes a banana-plug patch cord in the jack so the clip can grab terminals and hardware up to 0.300 in (7.62 mm). Not CAT-rated and limited to 150 Vrms; not for energized power circuits. Use 5916B for CAT-rated work.
items.rating: 150 Vrms, 5 A max, +50 °C max. No IEC CAT rating on the official datasheet.
items.notes: Official datasheet: sold in packages of 10 per color. These are not CAT-rated, unlike 5916B. Newark's page labels this '72924 Series,' which does not appear on the official Pomona datasheet or product page (model is 2240).
field_notes: Only 150 Vrms / 5 A and not CAT-rated. Not for 208/480 V or any energized power circuit.
Use 5916B when you need a CAT-rated clip.

items.name: Banana jack to #8–#10 spade lug adapter, red/black set
items.use: Converts a banana-plug lead to a bare-metal spade lug for #8 or #10 screw terminals and binding posts. No handheld, AC or CAT rating, so use only on de-energized or low-voltage test setups.
items.rating: 5000 VDC, 15 A, +50 °C max. No handheld limit, AC rating or CAT rating stated on the official datasheet.
items.notes: Official product page lists 3777A-02 as a set of one black and one red ('Banana Jack/Spade Lug 8-10'). The official datasheet's ordering table is an image ('see table above'); color and #8–#10 size are taken from that official product-page model list.
field_notes: No handheld, AC or CAT rating. Bare-metal spade lug.
Land it on de-energized terminals, or low-voltage test setups only.

items.name: Banana jack to 1.6 mm (.063 in) pin-tip adapter, black
items.use: Banana jack on one end accepts a standard banana plug; the other end is a 0.063 in (1.60 mm) male pin that plugs into a matching 16-size socket contact on a multi-pin connector. Low-voltage connector testing only; not for energized power circuits.
items.rating: 3 A. Do not hold in hand above 33 Vrms / 70 Vdc; 2500 Vrms max hands-free; +55 °C max. No IEC CAT rating on the official datasheet.
items.notes: Official datasheet groups models 3561/3563/3565/4691; 3563 is the 16 AWG / 0.063 in (1.60 mm) pin. Official product-page title says 'Banana Plug Test Adapter,' but the banana end is a jack that accepts a banana plug. Newark lists 13 A / 2.5 kV, which conflicts with the official 3 A / 2500 Vrms hands-free figures; official datasheet used here.
field_notes: Only 3 A. Don't hold it on live parts above 33 Vrms / 70 Vdc.
Low-voltage connector testing only, not for energized power circuits.

items.name: Magnetic Cable Organizer/ Document Holder
items.use: A magnetic holder that sticks to a metal panel or cabinet so a tech can park test leads and comms cables, or clip up a drawing, while working.
items.rating: No electrical rating published.
items.notes: Brand on the shop page is Lockout Labs (SKU LL26005); there's no separate maker product page. Shown white in the shop photos. Listed out of stock when checked.
items.material: ABS plastic with embedded magnets (stated on the shop page).
field_notes: The shop page says it is for organizing test leads, communication cables, and other small items, or for displaying drawings and documents, and that it holds on metal surfaces.
No electrical or CAT rating is stated. This is an organizer, not a protective barrier.

items.name: CT Test Stud Holder (CT Test Studs Sold Separately)
items.use: A five-position carry holder for CT test studs, so a tech can keep the studs together, see that all five are present, and clip the holder to a bag or belt loop before leaving the job.
items.rating: No electrical rating published.
items.notes: Holder only; CT test studs are sold separately. The shop also sells a holder with a 5-pack of studs, and a red 5-pack of studs on their own. Includes an attachment ring and carabiner. Shown green in the shop photo.
field_notes: This listing is the holder only. CT test studs are sold separately; the shop also sells a holder that comes with a 5-pack of studs, and a red 5-pack of studs on their own.
The shop page says it holds up to five studs, gives a quick visual check that all five are accounted for, and includes an attachment ring and carabiner. No material or electrical rating is stated.

items.name: Terminal Blocker Single (Pack Of 10)
items.use: Marks conductors to be removed from a terminal block and adds a non-conductive spacer while lifted conductors are moved or removed. Unrated aid; not a substitute for de-energizing and verifying absence of voltage.
items.rating: No electrical rating published.
items.notes: Single-blocker 10-pack. Double ($36.00) and triple ($45.50) 10-packs are separate listings. Shown red in the shop photos.
field_notes: The shop page says these can identify conductors that need to be removed from a terminal block, and can provide non-conductive isolation when moving or removing conductors so they do not short between terminals.
No material, voltage, or CAT rating is stated. This is the single-blocker 10-pack, not the double ($36.00) or triple ($45.50) packs, which are separate listings.
Unrated. Treat lifted conductors as live until LOTO and absence of voltage are verified.

items.name: Wire Caps 16/14 AWG (Pack Of 50)
items.use: Caps that slip over the ends of 16 or 14 AWG conductors during install or removal so they're easy to identify and less likely to touch other conductive parts. No voltage rating; not rated insulation or a permanent termination.
items.rating: No electrical rating published.
items.notes: Pack of 50, sized for 16/14 AWG. A 12/10 AWG 50-pack is a separate listing. Shown red in the shop photos.
field_notes: Sized for 16/14 AWG. The shop page says they keep conductors isolated and identifiable during removal or installation, and help prevent accidental contact with other conductive components.
No material, voltage, or CAT rating is stated. This is a pack of 50. The shop also sells a 12/10 AWG 50-pack, which is a different listing.
Unrated. Treat capped conductors as live until LOTO and absence of voltage are verified.

items.name: Back Probe Kit for Multimeter Test Leads, 10-piece (0.7 mm needle)
items.use: Thin 0.7 mm back-probe pins that plug onto standard 4 mm banana test leads, so you can slip into the back of a connector or terminal and take a low-voltage reading without piercing the insulation. Low-voltage and automotive circuits only.
items.rating: 30 V / 1 A max (stated on the Amazon listing and molded on the handles). No CAT rating.
items.material: Stainless steel pins with a PA insulation shell (stated on the Amazon listing).
items.notes: 10-piece kit: 5 red and 5 black pins. 84 mm overall, 20 mm needle, 0.7 mm pin, 4 mm banana socket. Sold on Amazon by DeeCam; brand is CNHIDEE.
field_notes: Rated 30 V / 1 A max with no CAT rating. For low-voltage and automotive back-probing only. Not for 120 V control circuits, panelboards, or anything above 30 V, and don't run more than 1 A through them on the amps jack.
Meant for probing connectors from the rear with a meter lead. The listing also markets them for piercing insulation; that's not the use here, since it can damage the wire or its seal.
The listing mentions plastic pin covers, but they aren't shown in the product photos, so they aren't confirmed as included.

items.name: Circuit Breaker Testing Tulips, 6-piece traditional electrode
items.use: A six-piece set of traditional tulip electrodes for primary-injection testing of molded-case circuit breakers. Imperial sizes that fit most common MCCB types, with the size engraved on each electrode. Output cables from the test set to the tulips are sold separately.
items.rating: No electrical rating published.
items.notes: Six-piece traditional set. Imperial sizes 3/16, 7/32, 1/4, 5/16, 3/8, and 1/2 in, engraved on each electrode. Ampteks also sells a 7-piece set and a 13-piece set as separate listings. Output cables are sold separately. No manufacturer part number is published on the product page.
field_notes: This listing is the 6-piece traditional set. Ampteks also sells a 7-piece set and a 13-piece set, which are separate listings.
Output cables to connect a primary-injection test set to the tulips are sold separately; the shop points to its 6 ft singles as the usual choice.
No voltage, current, or CAT rating is published for the electrodes. Don't assume a rating from the breaker sizes they are meant to fit.

items.name: Primary Injection Testing Tulips, 7-piece electrode set (base + 6 electrodes)
items.use: A tulip electrode set for primary-injection testing of molded-case circuit breakers: one electrode base plus six electrodes in imperial sizes (3/16, 7/32, 1/4, 5/16, 3/8 and 1/2 in) that fit most common MCCB terminals, with the size engraved on each. The shop lists it for 100 A through 1200 A breakers in maintenance and commissioning testing. Output cables from the test set are sold separately.
items.rating: No electrical rating published.
items.notes: Seven-piece set: one electrode base and six electrodes. Listed at $513.00 on 2026-11-18. A different listing from the 6-piece traditional set. Output cables are sold separately.
field_notes: This is the 7-piece set with an electrode base, not the 6-piece traditional set (Cristian's card). Pick the electrode that matches the breaker's terminal size before you hook up the test set.
Output cables from the primary-injection test set to the tulips are sold separately; the shop says its 6 ft singles are the most popular choice.
No voltage, current, or CAT rating is published for the electrodes. The 100 A to 1200 A range is the breaker sizes the shop says they fit, not a rating for the tulips.

items.name: 5-inch 4 mm female to fork adapter leads (pair)
items.use: A pair of short adapter leads with a 4 mm female banana socket on one end and a fork terminal on the other, for landing a banana test lead on a screw terminal. The listing says the fork fits a #12 screw and works well with SEL relay screw terminals, for relay testing, temporary hookups, and bench or field use.
items.rating: No electrical rating published.
items.notes: Sold as a pair. The shop handle is 3-4mm-banana-to-fork; no manufacturer part number or SKU is published. The shop photo shows 18 AWG 200°C printed on the black lead jacket. That is not a voltage, current, or CAT rating.
field_notes: Sold as a pair. The listing says the fork easily fits a #12 screw and also works well with SEL relay screw terminals.
These are 5-inch leads, not a rigid banana-to-fork adapter. The shop lists them for relay testing, temporary hookups, and bench or field use.
No voltage, current, or CAT rating is published. Don't assume a rating from other 4 mm banana-to-fork adapters.

items.name: Insulated splice, 4 mm banana jack, black
items.use: An insulated 4 mm banana-jack splice that joins two sheathed banana plugs, so a DMM probe or test lead can be extended or coupled in line.
items.rating: 1,000 V CAT III, 36 A (IEC Rating and Current Max on the Cal Test CT2248 datasheet). The product page states 1000 V CAT III and 36 A.
items.material: Polyamide (nylon) body with nickel-plated brass contacts (datasheet and product page).
items.notes: Black color of the CT2248 series. The red CT2248-2 is a separate card. Cal Test also sells a black/red pair as kit CT2663. Official product image is a render. Newark does not list this part; Digi-Key and Mouser also carry it.
field_notes: Rated 1,000 V CAT III / 36 A on the Cal Test datasheet, for connecting two sheathed banana plugs.
This is the black part (CT2248-0). The red CT2248-2 is a separate listing, and Cal Test also sells the pair as kit CT2663.
A splice is only as safe as the leads you join with it. Don't use unsheathed banana plugs in a CAT-rated setup.

items.name: Insulated splice, 4 mm banana jack, red
items.use: The red color of the CT2248 insulated 4 mm banana-jack splice, for joining two sheathed banana plugs so a DMM probe or test lead can be extended or coupled in line.
items.rating: 1,000 V CAT III, 36 A (IEC Rating and Current Max on the Cal Test CT2248 datasheet). The product page states 1000 V CAT III and 36 A.
items.material: Polyamide (nylon) body with nickel-plated brass contacts (datasheet and product page).
items.notes: Red color of the CT2248 series. The black CT2248-0 is a separate card. Cal Test also sells a black/red pair as kit CT2663. Official product image is a render. Newark does not list this part; Digi-Key and Mouser also carry it.
field_notes: Rated 1,000 V CAT III / 36 A on the Cal Test datasheet, for connecting two sheathed banana plugs.
This is the red part (CT2248-2). The black CT2248-0 is a separate listing, and Cal Test also sells the pair as kit CT2663.
A splice is only as safe as the leads you join with it. Don't use unsheathed banana plugs in a CAT-rated setup.

items.name: 14 AWG silicone wire, 40 ft red and 40 ft black spools
items.use: A pair of 14 AWG flexible silicone-insulated wire spools, 40 ft red and 40 ft black, for building custom leads, jumpers, or battery and hookup wiring. The listing does not give a CAT rating, so this is not a finished test lead.
items.rating: 600 V (stated as Voltage Rating: 600V on the Amazon listing and on the spool labels in the product photo). Temperature range -60 °C to 200 °C (listing). No current or CAT rating published.
items.material: Tinned copper conductor with silicone rubber insulation (stated on the Amazon listing).
items.notes: Sold as a 40 ft red plus 40 ft black pair, ASIN B09VC6WZC8. Listing also states 400-strand 0.08 mm tinned copper (2.01 mm²) and OD 3.5 mm ± 0.1 mm. No manufacturer part number is published. Marketed for RC, automotive, battery, and general hookup use.
field_notes: The listing and spool labels state a 600 V rating and a -60 °C to 200 °C temperature range. No current or CAT rating is published.
This is unterminated hookup and battery wire, not a CAT-rated test lead. Don't use it as a handheld lead on energized power gear.
The pack is two 40 ft spools, one red and one black, 14 AWG.

items.name: Magnetic Cable Organizer, 2-pack
items.use: A 2-pack of magnetic leather loops for bundling cables or hanging them from a metal surface such as a cart, stand, or cabinet, so leads stay together and off the floor.
items.rating: No electrical rating published.
items.material: Polyurethane leather with dual 20 mm magnets (stated on the Pig Hog product page and the Amazon listing).
items.notes: Sold as a pack of two. The official page says each loop is 7.8 in × 1.3 in (200 mm × 34 mm) and carries a 1-year warranty. Newark does not list this part. The official site listed $14.95; the Amazon listing Cristian sent is $15.95.
field_notes: This is a cable organizer, not a protective barrier. No electrical or CAT rating is published.
The official page warns not to place it close to credit cards or other things that can be demagnetized.
Sold as a 2-pack. Loops can be stacked together or stuck to most metal surfaces.

items.name: Alligator clips with insulated boots, 22-piece red/black kit
items.use: A 22-piece kit of small metal alligator clips with red and black insulating boots, for temporary low-energy hookups, bench work, or DIY testing. These are not CAT-rated test clips.
items.rating: Current: below 5A (stated on the Amazon listing). No voltage or CAT rating published.
items.material: Metal clips with plastic insulating sleeves; listing says nickel-plated (Amazon listing).
items.notes: 22-piece kit, ASIN B07KZWB333. Listing size is 52×10 mm. Shown packed in a plastic case in the product photos. No manufacturer part number is published. The Amazon brand store title appears as WMY CONGCONG.
field_notes: The listing only states current below 5 A. No voltage or CAT rating is published.
These are small unrated clips for low-energy bench and DIY work. Not a substitute for CAT-rated test clips, and not for energized panelboards or power circuits.
22 pieces, red and black boots, about 52 mm long per the listing.

items.name: CT Test Stud Holder with 5-pack of test studs (orange studs)
items.use: A five-position holder that comes with a 5-pack of CT test studs, so a tech can keep the studs together, see that all five are present, and clip the holder to a bag or belt loop before leaving the job.
items.rating: No electrical rating published.
items.notes: Orange-stud variant (SKU PNS26010-O) of the holder-plus-studs listing, $60.00. The shop photo shows a green holder with five orange studs, an attachment ring, and a carabiner. The same listing also offers red (PNS26010-R) and true yellow (PNS26010-Y) at the same price. This is a different product from the holder-only card (PNS26010), which does not include studs.
field_notes: This listing includes the holder and a 5-pack of test studs. It is not the holder-only listing (PNS26010), which is a separate card.
Cristian's variant is orange studs (PNS26010-O). The shop photo shows the green holder with orange studs. The same listing also sells red and true yellow stud colors.
The shop page says the holder has five positions, a visual check that all five studs are present, and an attachment ring and carabiner. No electrical rating is stated.
